summary: G2 was claimed correctly and revalidated the exact candidate source plus current Supabase control-plane state, but this generic worker host cannot issue the two required public HTTP GETs. Both the integrated web fetch and direct curl failed before an HTTP request; curl cannot resolve either target hostname. Supabase independently reports the project ACTIVE_HEALTHY and audio-lab-page-audio-v1 ACTIVE v1, whose current source still defines GET-without-id health metadata with maxChars=1800. No POST generation, product mutation, promotion, or authority-pointer change occurred. Because the predecessor already required a direct-public-HTTP verifier and the allocator exposed this recovery with required_capabilities=[], this route is rejected as a capability-routing mismatch rather than counted as verification progress.
evidence: Supabase edge function audio-lab-page-audio-v1: ACTIVE v1; current GET-without-id source contract maxChars=1800
tests: PASS_AUTHORITY: deterministic G000002 recovery PIN won before work and STARTED claim references it.
PASS_SOURCE: gh-pages source contains tool:tts:generic-text-surface:v1, audio-lab-page-audio-v1 and MAX=1800.
PASS_CONTROL_PLANE: Supabase project is ACTIVE_HEALTHY; edge function audio-lab-page-audio-v1 is ACTIVE v1.
PASS_HEALTH_CONTRACT_SOURCE: current function source defines GET without id returning ok/service/engine/maxChars=1800/mode.
BOUNDARY_SERVED_HTTP: integrated web fetch blocked both exact target URLs before request.
BOUNDARY_SERVED_HTTP: direct curl exited 6 because neither juanmanuelpm.github.io nor catnohyouxqjjtseaueb.supabase.co resolves in this host.
PASS_NO_SIDE_EFFECT: no POST generation request was sent.
unresolved: From a verifier runtime with direct public HTTP/DNS, GET https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/__canary/portfolio-tts-generic-text-surface-v1/ and persist the served marker plus audio-lab-page-audio-v1 reference or exact origin HTTP failure.
From that runtime, GET https://catnohyouxqjjtseaueb.supabase.co/functions/v1/audio-lab-page-audio-v1 without id and persist the actual health response including maxChars=1800 or exact divergence.
Prevent generic /wc recovery routing for this job unless the host advertises direct public HTTP/DNS capability; required_capabilities=[] reproduced the predecessor boundary.
